# `repo.visibility.set`

Change repository visibility

- Method and path: `POST /{owner}/{repo}/settings/visibility`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie repo visibility set`

- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
